title: NBA: Shai says Thunder hungry for more after downing Spurs
summary: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander said the Oklahoma City Thunder are "hungry" for more success after exacting a small measure of revenge on the San Antonio Spurs in their NBA season-opener on Tuesday.
